cooldown_defaults_note: critical 5 min; warning 5-30 min per rule; info up to 6 h. All rows: exactly one open instance per dedupe key; re-fire requires the clear_condition first (same dedupe/hysteresis discipline as the queue design).

data_status_vocab.LIVE: fires today on verified EdgeSight fields only
data_status_vocab.PARTIAL: fires once the named in-flight upgrade ships and its calibrated fields exist; gated at runtime by field presence, never invented
data_status_vocab.FUTURE: requires POS / identity / age / external sensors; the UI must render these as catalog entries with an 'unavailable' chip and must never fire them from EdgeSight data alone

ui_never_fire_rule: runtime gate = data_status == LIVE AND all dependency fields present in the current snapshot/rollups; PARTIAL rows render 'pending calibration/upgrade'; FUTURE rows render 'requires external data source'. Idle-store or camera-outage gaps fire not-firable (absent rows), never fabricated zeros.
thresholds_note: thresholds without a verified code default (occupancy caps, throughput floor, abandon band) are marked operator-calibrated and stay disabled until set; queue rows fall back to verified defaults (max_comfortable_queue 4, congestion_threshold_seconds 120 s, no_staff_grace 30 s).

alerts.title: Customer waiting too long

trigger.condition: longest in-flight queue wait > alert_wait_ms (fallback: verified congestion_threshold_seconds 120 s), held 10 s

alerts.recommended_action: Send a floater to open a second till or assist at the queue head; check self-checkout staffing.
data_dependency: episodes (needs queue analytics upgrade, in flight)

alerts.title: Queue length over comfort

trigger.condition: queue_length > alert_length (fallback: verified max_comfortable_queue 4) held 10 s

alerts.recommended_action: Brief a colleague to the till; consider opening lane 2.

alerts.title: Active queue with nobody serving

trigger.condition: linked staff zone has 0 tagged staff >= 30 s (no_staff_grace_seconds) while QUEUE_WAIT_OVER or QUEUE_LENGTH_OVER is active

alerts.recommended_action: Dispatch nearest colleague to checkouts immediately.

alerts.title: Abandon rate high (lane losing customers)

trigger.condition: abandon_rate > abandon_threshold (operator-set, suggested default 15%) AND completed >= 10 settled outcomes AND service evidence exists (service_point or head_exit)

alerts.recommended_action: Walk the lane: pricing at head, basket limits, till speed; rebalance staffing at peak hours.

alerts.title: Store near occupancy limit

trigger.condition: store people_now >= 0.9 x store_capacity_people for 2 min

alerts.recommended_action: Stagger door entry; slow the queue merge; prep the over-limit procedure.

alerts.title: Store over occupancy limit
alerts.recommended_action: Hold entry at the door; open an immediate relief exit; log the event time for the duty record.

alerts.title: Entrance counted nobody for a long window

trigger.condition: business hours AND decode fps > 0 AND stream fresh AND entrance trip_in count == 0 for 30 min

alerts.recommended_action: Walk the door: locked? bypassed? Camera view shifted? Check the tripwire after your last calibration edit.

alerts.title: Camera feed down
alerts.recommended_action: Check camera power/RTSP link; dashboards will show NO DATA honestly, not zeros.

alerts.title: Edge throughput degraded

trigger.condition: infer/display fps < throughput_floor (operator floor, suggested 2.0) >= 5 min while decode_fps stays normal

alerts.recommended_action: Reduce EDGE_MAX_CAMERAS or imgsz, or switch perf modes; expect counts to lag what eyes see.

alerts.title: Zone crowding above cap
alerts.recommended_action: Open an adjacent lane or deflect foot traffic; restaff the zone.

alerts.title: Busy zone with zero staff visible

trigger.condition: zone occupancy >= busy_floor for 10 min AND staff_now == 0 during business hours

alerts.recommended_action: Move or schedule cover into the high-browse area.

alerts.title: Display interest unusually high

trigger.condition: category detections per window >= 3x same-hour rolling mean built from real product-window history

alerts.recommended_action: Face-up and restock the display; watch for stockout in the following hours.

alerts.title: Traction heatmap stale
alerts.recommended_action: Check disk space and heatmaps config; a truly idle camera can also lag writes (acceptable).
alerts.clear_condition: heatmap file newer than 2 x write interval

alerts.title: Promo conversion vs footfall

trigger.condition: promo redemptions / entries deviates beyond the operator band (requires POS tie-in)

alerts.recommended_action: Owned by the POS integration owner once receipts are linked (separate consented intake).

alerts.title: Abandoned-basket revenue lost

trigger.condition: graded queue-abandon events x POS price of the basket proxy

alerts.recommended_action: Retune staffing at abandonment-prone hours; the revenue numerator needs POS data.

alerts.title: Age-restricted checkout unattended

trigger.condition: person below the age threshold at a restricted till with no staff beside them

alerts.recommended_action: Compliance process: page a supervisor per the store SOP.
data_dependency: verified-age signal (NOT derivable from anonymized video; assumed-governed external source)

alerts.title: Returning visitor follow-up
data_dependency: cross-day identity (forbidden by design in this system)

alerts.title: Aisle chiller temperature excursion

trigger.condition: IoT sensor temperature outside the food-safety band for 5 min

alerts.recommended_action: Check the chiller unit; complete the food-safety log per SOP.
data_dependency: IoT temperature sensors (NOT in edge data; video never substitutes for a thermometer)
alerts.clear_condition: sensor back in band for 10 min
